description: Publish a multi-file static site from an authenticated account. Pass files as an array of {path, content} strings; the root must contain index.html or index.htm. Returns a /s/<id>/ URL that serves HTML/CSS/JS/assets. Limits: 200 files, 20 MB total, 5 MB per file. Requires OAuth or an API key; site links never show the anonymous badge. Use idempotencyKey to make retries safe.

files.description: Site files. Paths are relative and must not contain .. or absolute paths.

path.description: Relative path, e.g. index.html or assets/app.css.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional 1-128 char retry key. Reusing it with the same payload returns the original site; the edit token is only returned to the original caller.

name: upload_site
